entry_points.text: Init validation exercises table transforms across protections and mutating ops under matching locks, then tears down.
Range invalidation collects locked present and shadow entries, evicts, deactivates busy survivors, purges shadow, yields between batches.
Hint entries take descriptor, offset, length and advice. Empty descriptor gives bad-descriptor. Variants share helper preferring per-file with generic fallback.

exports.text: Supply virtual areas and file folios. Virtual-area fails null on exhaustion. Folio path prefers NUMA policy and promotes large to remappable.
Lower-table locked and lockless access. Locked restarts on upper change. Lockless refuses absent, non-present, huge or malformed upper.
Generic advice adjusts caching, triggers prefetch, or discards range data per hint.
Ranged, full-mapping and budgeted write initiation with sync or non-waiting posture, skipping non-writeback or clean mappings.
Move staged folios toward reclaim in local, single-processor and system-wide forms.
Forced population caps to device optimal or window, splits into bounded chunks, skips mappings without reads.
Insertion charges, locks, delegates to low-level insert, handles refault activation and reclaim joining on success, unwinds on failure.
Deactivation skips unevictable or unmanaged, may use generational clearing, else batches. Compaction drops exceptional entries preserving order.
Conditional eviction refuses bad state or excess refs, else removes. Replacement exchanges at same index. Range invalidation uses shared try-invalidate.

hazards.text: Malformed upper during lockless lookup is reported and cleared instead of mapping.
Addition draining isolates folios hitting zero refs mid-drain, freeing via separate batch after unlock.
Removing mapped or dirty folio warns and taints with narrow mitigation. Release and deletion expect locked folios, replacement both locked, count init non-tail zero-count.

invariants.text: Prefer largest huge backing for trial frames, degrading to smaller huge then single page, skipping dependent checks on failure.
Lockless upper sampling has two builds: preserving interrupt state or no masking.

Writeback pins inode. Need=nonzero residency. Range checks reject inverted, skip encoded, detect dirty/locked/writeback. Errors use I/O precedence, consume vs preserve; per-file cursor lockless plus locked advance with tracing. Waits scan tags in batches. Write-and-wait skips inverted/empty, waits except I/O failure. Tracepoints on.
Direct-access or no-op accepts valid hints without effect, rejects unknown. Discard keeps partial edges and end page unless aligned or at end. Zero length is unbounded with clamp and wrap guard.
Split removal only for large remappable queued folios with fast emptiness test. Unevictable mapping or lock mark forbids eviction. Lock staging packs op into low bits stripped before use.
Activation draining has present and absent builds; present forwards batches. Lock draining and pending checks have active and no-op builds on dedicated per-processor batch.
Bounded prefetch derives end from host size, skips empty or past-end, trims overlong. Alloc uses minimum order, propagates dropbehind. Submission prefers vector read, else single reads, exits empty.

Insert needs locked folio meeting order and alignment, links mapping and position, merges shadow splitting oversized except memory-backed abort, on failure detaches preserving position. Shadow callbacks only for ordinary mappings.

Joining rejects queued or active-plus-unevictable, promotes on fault outside atomic use, buffers per-processor, ignores detached except addition. Activation queued or immediate. Generational: unevictable hot, first touch promotes, saturate to working set, disabled cold; clearing checks minimum match.

Deletion installs shadow, detaches preserving position, adjusts counters with exemptions. Batched removal clears links, subtracts size, skips encoded. Shadow reclaim skips shmem and direct-access, else empties and queues hosts. Presence rejects inverted, ignores encoded, unpinned. Tagged walk fills batch overflow-safe.

Release needs locked folio, fails under writeback, prefers mapping op with buffer fallback. Scans skip out-of-interval large or multi-slot values, need nonblocking lock. Lookup retries transient, returns absent or shadow unelevated, else elevates and revalidates.

Policy resolves node and mask. Preferred overrides node, bind restricts mask, huge may try local-only sans reclaim. Interleaving validates sequence, reads weights read-side with fallback, supports stateless and stateful progression.

locks.text: Validation holds lock matching tested level: lower mapped lock, middle locks, address-space lock upper.
Flag changes under file lock; window adjustments unlocked. Presence, tagged and weight reads read-side without tree locks via retry, skip or fallback.

Batch relocks vectors irq-disabled. System drain serializes with ordered generation. Local drains per-processor irq-aware. In-batch scans local only; immediate drops membership before lock, restores after.
Split detachment under read-side protection holding node and group aware list lock.
Bounded prefetch holds shared invalidation protection across unbounded call, which requires it.
Removal needs locked folio with host and cache locks, runs free hook before dropping refs. Unlock wakes only on waiter evidence via hashed table.
Shadow holds host nesting IRQ tree lock. Batched deletion holds host and IRQ tree locks, frees after unlock. Replacement needs both locked, holds IRQ tree lock, frees after unlock.

state_machines.text: Locked residency moves by evictability and nesting with distinct accounting. Access leaves dropbehind cold, uses generational counting when on, else advances toward active.
Discard escalates from local flush with first invalidation to global flush with second pass on remote residency.
Lower mapping samples upper lockless, acquires derived lock, restarts on divergence.
Unbounded aligns start, preallocates at minimum order, flushes on present or conflict, flags marker, tracks refault, defers I/O failures.
Error moves set to observed to cleared or advanced. Waits preserve set until done, still wait except I/O failure, advance per-file cursors independently clearing legacy flags.

structs.text: Per-processor staging groups queues for addition, tail, deactivation, lazy release and activation.
Fixture bundles address space with accessors, trial address, frames, swap and migration placeholders. Protection spans empty to shared plus execute, write and read.
Mapping with residency, flags, host, ops and tree; folios with link, position, order and flags; readahead cursor with batch, evidence and dropbehind; file with mapping, cursor, lock and ops.
Forced uses two-megabyte units scaled by page size. Unlock assumes waiter bit seven with locked at or below. Advice reports bad-descriptor; errors space-shortage and I/O failure.
